subject: AWS Marketplace: ResellerCo private offer — kickoff & next steps

Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff — ResellerCo / Redwood private offer (AWS)

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. ResellerCo is ready to move forward with an AWS Channel Partner Private Offer (we typically call it CPPO) to resell Redwood to a set of joint customers.

Two asks to kick off:
- Can you share the AWS private-offer checklist and any template SOW we should align on?
- Let's book a short kickoff to align discounts, price floor, and timeline for the private offer creation in AWS.

Our internal team: Jane Lin (me), Tim O'Rourke (sales ops), and Maria Gomez (legal on copy).

Happy to be flexible — can we do Thursday 11–11:30 PT or Friday 9–9:30 PT?

Best,
Jane
Head of Alliances, ResellerCo
[jane.lin@resellerco.com | +1 415-555-0198]

Jane — thanks, excited to get this moving. Thursday 11 PT works for me; locking that. Inviting a short agenda: pricing/discount band, list of target customers, procurement timeline, and who will create the private offer in AWS (ResellerCo vs Redwood).

I attached a CPPO checklist we use (aws-cppo-checklist.xlsx) and a draft SOW our partnerships team prefers as a starting point. Marissa — looping you for procurement/legal sync. Sergio — can you bring the marketplace ops steps?

Agenda (15m):
1) Confirm pricing band & price floor
2) Confirm who creates private offer in AWS and timeline
3) DocuSign/NDAs and next steps

See you Thu 11–11:30 PT (invite sent).

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Quick follow from legal/procurement POV.

Ben — thanks for the checklist. A couple of notes to prep before Thu:
- I'll need ResellerCo's legal contact and if they want a reseller amendment or a standard partner SOW. If reseller-sow-draft.pdf is from them, send the redlines after the call.
- Pricing floor: procurement needs an internal approval if discount >25% off list. If we expect to go deeper we should get an escalation path pre-authorized.
- Attachments to include in the AWS private-offer record: reseller-sow-draft.pdf and resellergroup-ndas.pdf (we'll need countersigned NDAs before we publish for some customers).

Putting a pre-call checklist in Drive and sharing the link in a follow-up.

Marissa
Sr Manager, Partnerships Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Jane Lin <jane.lin@resellerco.com>

Cc: Tim O'Rourke <tim@resellergroup.io>, AWS Partner Rep <accountmgr@aws-partners.com>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@resellerco.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff — ResellerCo / Redwood private offer (AWS)

Ben/Marissa — thanks for the materials and the clarity. Thu's call was helpful. Two quick items from our side:

1) Pricing: ResellerCo is comfortable proposing up to 22% off list for the initial private offer to accelerate early customers. If Redwood needs an approval route for 23–30% we need a named approver.
2) DocuSign: sending the reseller agreement this afternoon for Redwood countersign. Please confirm who will sign on Redwood's side (Ben vs Legal).

Also: Tim will coordinate with AWS on the private-offer creation. Tim's note: AWS requires the offer to include the exact SKU mapping and a statement of fulfillment responsibilities. He asked if Redwood will provide SKU IDs or if ResellerCo should create the offer and we then accept.

Thanks — will upload a signed NDA once countersigned internally.

Best,
Jane

Attachment: resellergroup-ndas.pdf
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Approval request — ResellerCo discount & AWS private offer creation

Ben/Priyom — per the kickoff and ResellerCo's ask for a 22% off list initial private offer:
- I recommend we approve up to 22% for the pilot cohort (customers < $50k ARR). Anything beyond 22% requires Sales VP approval.
- For AWS private-offer ops: ResellerCo can create the offer draft in AWS CPPO portal using the SKU mapping we will provide; Redwood will accept the offer and set fulfillment terms. This keeps the offer creation in partner's workspace which accelerates publishing.

Action items: 
1) Priyom — please prepare the SKU mapping CSV and the short fulfillment statement (1 paragraph) by EOD Wed so Tim/AWS can publish the draft.
2) Ben — confirm you're the signer for the reseller agreement or if Legal should do countersign.

I'll prepare the internal approval note for Sales VP in case we need to push past 22%.

Sergio
Director, Platform Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Subject: Next steps & links — ResellerCo private offer (AWS)

Jane/Tim — thanks for the coordination. Quick confirmation and next steps from Redwood: 

1) Signing: I'll countersign the reseller agreement once Legal confirms no material changes (Marissa, please advise if we need Legal to sign instead).
2) Pricing band: Redwood approves up to 22% for the pilot cohort (Sergio noted escalation to Sales VP required >22%).
3) SKU mapping: Priyom attached the SKU CSV to the HubSpot deal record and copied the file to the Drive link below. Priyom — please send the CSV directly to Tim (tim@resellergroup.io) so AWS can ingest the mapping.
4) AWS private-offer link: ResellerCo (or Tim/AWS) should create the private offer draft at the AWS console link below; once created, Redwood will accept and finalize fulfillment terms.

AWS private offer (example): https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/management/private-offers/offer/abcd-1234
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/67890 (deal ID: RDW-2026-AWS-4567)
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/envelope/0A1B2C3D (reseller agreement)

Tim/Jane — proposed timeline:
- Wed EOD: ResellerCo publishes draft private offer in AWS with SKU mapping
- Thu: Redwood accepts offer and countersigns reseller agreement
- Following week: pilot onboarding for first joint customer

Please reply if any of the items above need adjustments. Attaching the checklist and SOW we referenced.

Best,
Ben Carter
